quality.label: Stream Quality
quality.description: Preferred streaming quality. Lossless needs a nugs.net plan that includes HiFi streaming; lossy is used otherwise, or when a show isn't available in lossless.

option_descriptions.lossless: CD quality or better. Plays on any device.
option_descriptions.lossy: Compressed stream, uses the least bandwidth.

manifest.description: Stream official live concert audio & video — new shows added regularly to a rich archive.
